title: Console UX go-to-market sprint ops and training matrix
creator: Sofia Rivera
description: Coordinated GTM plan for a console UX release that includes new dashboards (cost breakdowns), rollout controls, and training materials for internal and customer-facing teams. Focus on adoption, measurable quality signals, and low-friction enablement.
objectives: Ship dashboard view with per-route cost breakdown and token-level swimlane in Console
Expose rollout controls (canary + percentage rollouts) to customers with audit trail
Prepare release notes, in-product banners, and enablement training for SEs/CS/PD
Ensure metrics and dashboards are instrumented for post-launch health and adoption
scope: Console: Dashboards - cost-breakdown panel and per-model time-series
Console: Rollouts - canary percentage selector, rollback, and audit logs
Docs: Release notes and migration guide for customers updating SDK routes
Training: 2 internal live sessions + recorded walkthrough + quick reference sheets
Exclusions: Backend runtime changes (separate runtime-1.21 project)
timeline: 2026-03-01: Feature freeze for console UI; first internal demo
2026-03-10: Draft release notes and customer messaging; stakeholder review
2026-03-18: Run SE training session #1; collect FAQs
2026-03-31: Gradual ramp to 100% if health metrics are green
launch_steps: Finalize UI copy and accessibility review (Design)
Complete API contract review and update SDK changelog (Eng)
Publish draft release notes and send to legal/compliance review
Create recording and slide deck for SE/CS training
Provision canary cohort and add metrics to operations dashboard
Prepare rollback runbook and postmortem template
release_notes_draft: Feature: Cost Insights dashboard — per-route and per-model token breakdowns
Feature: Rollout Controls — canary deployments with percentage targets and automatic rollback
Improvements: Console performance optimizations for dashboard load time
Migration: No forced migration; clients using pinned model versions unaffected
Known issues: CSV export pagination; scheduled fix in next patch
training_plan: Internal Live #1 (03-18): Product walkthrough + common troubleshooting scenarios
Internal Live #2 (03-23): Deep-dive for solutions engineers and support
Recorded walk-through (by 03-20): 12-minute highlight reel hosted on Drive
Quick Reference: 1-page PDF with common commands, dashboard filters, and rollback steps
Customer webinar (post-GA): 45-minute session with Q&A scheduled in April
comms_plan: Pre-announcement to active customers by SEs (one week before canary)
In-product banner during canary with opt-in link for feedback
Release notes published to docs.redwood.ai and included in weekly changelog
Marketing blog & tweet thread on GA day with high-level customer stories
Segmented email to enterprise admins outlining audit logs and compliance features
dependencies: ENG-11872: API change - add rollout_percentage param
ENG-12190: Audit logging service update for rollout events
DES-2203: Finalized dashboard wireframe and copy
DOCS-491: Release notes template and migration guide
risks: Telemetry gaps: missing token-level metrics could hinder adoption measurement
Performance: dashboard queries may exceed SLO under high-cardinality filters
Compliance sign-off delay from Legal could push GA date
Customer confusion if rollout semantics differ from previous feature flags
metrics_and_SLOs: Adoption: % of active accounts that view Cost Insights within first 30 days
Reliability: Dashboard 95th pct latency < 2s for typical queries
Support load: number of console-related tickets in first week compared to baseline
qa_checks: E2E: Create test tenant and exercise 0%, 5%, 50%, 100% rollouts
Data integrity: validate cost breakdown numbers against billing pipeline
UI: accessibility audit and keyboard navigation coverage
Scale: run synthetic load to validate dashboard performance at 10k queries/hour
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Internal opt-in: product + SE teams test feature (03-10 to 03-14)
Phase 1 - Canary 5%: selected customers with active usage (03-24 to 03-28)
Phase 2 - Progressive ramp: 25% -> 50% over 3 days pending health checks
Phase 3 - GA: full enablement and GA comms (target 04-01)
